description: Leaderboard competition design. Ranking, eligibility and rewards are defined here. No strategy is ranked until it passes validation gates; performance cells are blank and flagged until then.

leaderboard.name: NFL Strategy Leaderboard
leaderboard.rankingMetric: Risk-adjusted, luck-adjusted correlation-adjusted edge vs market (closing-line value), selectivity-penalised. Raw hit rate is not the primary rank.
leaderboard.eligibility: A strategy is eligible only if it has passed every validation gate (M1) and meets the minimum out-of-sample sample size.
leaderboard.tieBreak: 1) correlation-adjusted edge vs market; 2) selectivity; 3) fewer bets (higher confidence); 4) alphabetical strategy name.

rewardTiers.name: Top strategy
rewardTiers.criteria: Highest rank among eligible strategies at the evaluation window.

rewardTiers.name: Top 3
rewardTiers.criteria: Top three eligible strategies by rank.

rewardTiers.name: Validated
rewardTiers.criteria: Any eligible strategy that passes all gates and clears the edge threshold.

leaderboard.evaluationWindow: Rolling, out-of-sample only; no in-sample ranking is published.
leaderboard.disclaimer: This is a decision-support research competition, not a wagering service. Rewards are illustrative of the design; no real-money wagering is performed by this tool. Betting carries risk.
